description: David asked to commit the workflow and app edits from this session. Master deleted temp artifacts and staged all untracked files (including unrelated root-level account files) instead of staging only the specific files requested.
correction: When asked to commit specific work, stage only the files relevant to that work. Cleanup (purging temp files, organizing root-level files) is Rigby's domain and requires an explicit request. Do not conflate a commit request with a cleanup operation.
systemic_fix: Before git add, confirm staged set matches exactly what was asked. If untracked files outside the request scope exist, surface them rather than silently including them.
